posts.name: Anupam Chandra
posts.cooked:
Folks,

This is for future batches. Given below is a link to all the OPPE 1 questions that came for my group on 19 November 2021. Since the institute won’t help us prepare for OPPE questions, nor will they share questions from previous OPPEs, crowd sourcing previous year OPPE questions will help all future batches. Please contribute as much as you can.

Google Drive

System Commands - OPPE questions - Google Drive

In case anyon else has questions from previous year OPPEs, please start pasting the links or typing out the questions in this thread. Do not forget to mention whether the questions relate to OPPE 1 or OPPE 2.

To help search for this document - People will search for this document using the keywords OPPE1 PYQ, OPPE 1 PYQ, PYQs, OPPE1 PYQs, OPPE PYQs, SC OPPE PYQs, SC OPPE1 PYQs, System Commands OPPE PYQs, SC OPPE questions etc.

Regards,
Anupam
